parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.text: What is the meaning of the word “wrist”? How many things are there here? Her hair is on her head. His chin, mouth and nose are on his face. My eyes are blue. The people of Scandinavia are tall. He's asking us a question. The name of her country is Germany. Have you got any ears? Yes, two.
